summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Pop Culture Group Co., Ltd reporting the adoption of an amended and restated memorandum and articles of association, approved by shareholders on May 15, 2026, and filed in the Cayman Islands on June 24, 2026. The amendments are routine corporate governance updates and do not involve any acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or abrupt management change. The document defines share capital structure (Class A, B, C ordinary shares) but contains no transactional terms, prices, premiums, recommendations, or deal mechanics.
